name: Epic Pizza Mossel Bay
address: Santos Beach, Santos Bay, Mossel Bay, 6510, South Africa
description_short: Wood-fired pizzas served steps from Santos Beach with ocean breezes and sunset views.
description_long:
Epic Pizza Mossel Bay brings authentic wood-fired pizza to one of the Garden Route's most beautiful beachfront locations. Set at Santos Beach, this relaxed pizzeria combines quality ingredients with that unbeatable coastal atmosphere – there's something about eating pizza with sand between your toes and the sound of waves nearby.

The menu keeps things simple and focused, with wood-fired pizzas that deliver proper char and flavour. Whether you're coming off the beach after a swim or settling in for sunset, the location makes every meal feel special. The casual vibe works for families during the day and couples in the evening.

Being right on Santos Beach means you can watch the ocean while you eat, and the outdoor seating makes the most of Mossel Bay's generous weather. It's the kind of spot where locals grab a quick bite and visitors linger longer than planned.
